dedupe_keys.name: healthcare mri demand and capacity simulation

description: This Python resource, published by Saurav Singla, models MRI demand and patient flow through reception, preparation, scanning and reporting. It provides priority dispatch, scanner and staff capacity, maintenance, failures, abandonment and replicated uncertainty analysis. Users supply demand and scenario settings and obtain queues, utilisation, completion counts and comparative capacity results through Python, command-line tools or a Streamlit dashboard. The repository documents an aggregate NHS provider-month forecasting benchmark and a partial reproduction of the author's 2020 study; coverage is globally configurable and the simulator needs local inputs for new sites. Public source, Docker instructions and CSV/JSON evidence exports are free under MIT. A material limitation is that original proprietary Simul8 files, some arrival parameters and random streams are unavailable, so exact reproduction is not claimed. The aggregate forecasting comparison does not validate patient-level event behaviour or operational safety. This model supports healthcare-capacity scenario analysis and is complementary to model-simpy-streamlit-healthcare-des. The README reports tests and forecasting scores, but this review did not reproduce those results or treat them as independent verification.
